chapter: Benny Meroff and Chicago's jazz scene
title: Touring the country by Meroff's private train
summary: When theater business collapses Meroff takes a reorganized band across the US by special train, with a chorus-girl car and a parlor car.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: said to us - it looks like we're going to have to go out on the road and with that, the whole band didn't go because, you know, some of the musicians-- because you know how a lot of musicians are about their home towns --
So, we had to reorganize the Meroff Band and we travelled by special train and we toured the whole United States.
Now, this is towards the end of your time with Meroff.

Yes - it's going into '31 because I left Meroff in '31 and, uh, of course, we're in the Depression and we're in it real bad at this point; things were really bad and we were a very lucky band to be working and surprising enough, Meroff got enough work - we even had a special train with 'Benny Meroff' painted on the side of it and all steel cars and all this kind of thing and, uh, we had one car for the chorus girls and one car for the principals and one car for the band and, then, in between, was a parlor car - which they called a parlor car in those days, club car - actually - and a dining car and, so, if any of the fellows didn't want to go to a hotel when we used to work in a town a week - we could live on the train-- which a lot of us did. And, of course, those trips are fantastic.
And you were out -- I know you went as far as South Dakota ---

Oh, we went every place--- we changed from one railroad to another; you know, they'd come in with an engine and pull us onto another railway because, you know, all the railroads intercrossed through the United States. And, we looked forward to those rides, because I could remember - all the chorus girls had one car and they had sort of a den mother and on that night that we were going to travel, we proceeded to get her loaded, at which time---
